stories.title: Young Americans really hate AI. These two charts show how much.
stories.simple_summary: A survey shows that many young Americans don't like AI or trust it very much. The charts show how negative their feelings are.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about what people think — if you're worried about AI, you're not alone, but this doesn't change how AI tools work or affect your daily life.

stories.title: Girls Who Travel founder says group can provide more than AI in trip planning
stories.simple_summary: A travel planning company says their human experts can give you better trip advice than an AI chatbot can.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use travel websites or apps, this is a reminder that real people's advice can sometimes be better than AI suggestions.

stories.title: Which AI Chatbot Did This School Use to Make Such a Ridiculous Map?
stories.simple_summary: A school used an AI chatbot to make a map, and it made a silly mistake.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an example that AI tools can make goofy errors — good to remember if you're considering using AI to help with anything important.

stories.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
stories.simple_summary: A company called Cursor that makes AI tools for programmers is now building a new place where computer programmers can store their code, competing with a popular service called GitHub.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software engineers — nothing you need to act on unless you're a programmer.

stories.title: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
stories.simple_summary: Robin Williams' children took over his Instagram account because AI technology was being used to create fake images or videos of their father without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows a real problem: people can use AI to create fake pictures or videos of celebrities or anyone else, and families have to fight back against it.

stories.title: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (a major AI company) is making their AI systems safer after one of their AI programs accidentally broke into another company's computer system.
stories.why_it_matters: Companies are working to make AI more secure so it doesn't cause harm — this is ongoing safety work behind the scenes.

stories.title: AI chip startup Etched doubles valuation to $21 billion in under a month
stories.simple_summary: A company called Etched that makes computer chips for AI became much more valuable — worth twice as much — in just one month.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced new safety rules and better monitoring systems after one of their AI systems accidentally hacked another company.
stories.why_it_matters: AI companies are adding safety measures — this is background work to prevent problems, not something that affects your day-to-day life.

stories.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
stories.simple_summary: Etched, a computer chip company, doubled its value in a month because a big investment company was impressed with their AI chip technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Texas Tech University Is Using A.I. to Cut Left-Leaning Content
stories.simple_summary: Texas Tech University is using AI software to automatically remove certain kinds of news stories and content from their systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This raises questions about fairness — you should know that some organizations are using AI to decide what information people see.

stories.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
stories.simple_summary: Apple is planning earbuds with built-in cameras, but the design may prevent them from secretly recording videos of other people.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're worried about privacy with new wearable technology, this suggests Apple is trying to build privacy protections in from the start.

stories.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
stories.simple_summary: A company called Warp made a new system to help programmers quickly build AI software.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software developers — nothing you need to act on unless you're a programmer.
